title: SkyrimNet Whipped
tagline: A padded whip that wounds face, back, arms and legs, and the wounds heal over time.
description:
Ships two prompts for injuries: a character-bio section describing what each wounded body part looks like, and a final-instructions section describing how it feels. Injuries (whip wounds, plus slashing, piercing, bludgeoning, burning, freezing, shocking, mauling and generic damage) are tracked per body part (face, back, arms, legs) by `SkyrimNet_Whipped.dll`, moving from light to severe damage, then through healing; the text comes from `SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet_Whipped/injuries/*.json`. Requires `SkyrimNet_Whipped.esp` and `SkyrimNet_Whipped.dll`.

Plugin menu settings stay in `config/plugins/SkyrimNet_Whipped/` (`whip.*` keys). Hit narration and the Whip_Target action live in this mod's Papyrus scripts.
author: goodprovider
